description:
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Razortide Bridge, untapping Ancient Den.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Ancient Den from the battlefield to your hand, returning Razortide Bridge from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Ancient Den, untapping any applicable permanent.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Razortide Bridge from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
